title: Marine & Family Support
intro: Welcome to Marine Corps Community Services. We are excited you are here and encourage you to browse freely through our many programs and services.

sections.heading: Child and Youth
sections.markdown:
Child and Youth Programs provide high-quality childcare programs and services that support eligible service members and their families.

**Programs:**
- [Child Development Centers](https://pendleton.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/child-and-youth/child-development-centers)
- [Exceptional Family Member Program](https://pendleton.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/military-family-life/exceptional-family-member-program)
- [Family Child Care](https://pendleton.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/child-and-youth/family-child-care)
- [New Parent Support](https://pendleton.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/child-and-youth/new-parent-support)
- [School Liaison](https://pendleton.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/child-and-youth/school-liaison)
- [School Age Care](https://pendleton.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/child-and-youth/school-age-care)
- [Youth & Teen Program](https://pendleton.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/child-and-youth/youth-teen-program)

sections.heading: Information, Referral, and Relocation
sections.markdown: We connect service members and their families to valuable resources, helping them successfully navigate transitions and access community support.

sections.heading: Libraries
sections.markdown: We enrich the lives of our military community by fostering opportunities for connection and providing access to diverse resources and services.

sections.heading: Military Family Life
sections.markdown:
Integrating and aligning vital support services to meet the current and future needs of the unit.

**Programs:**
- [Chaplains Religious Enrichment Development Operation](https://pendleton.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/military-family-life/chaplains-religious-enrichment-development-operation)
- [Exceptional Family Member Program](https://pendleton.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/military-family-life/exceptional-family-member-program)
- [Family Advocacy Program](https://pendleton.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/military-family-life/family-advocacy-program)
- [Family Member Employment Assistance Program](https://pendleton.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/military-family-life/family-member-employment-assistance-program)
- [Family Readiness Program](https://pendleton.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/military-family-life/family-readiness-program)
- [Life Skills](https://pendleton.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/military-family-life/life-skills)
- [L.I.N.K.S.](https://pendleton.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/military-family-life/l-i-n-k-s)
- [Marine Corps Family Team Building](https://pendleton.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/military-family-life/marine-corps-family-team-building)
- [New Parent Support](https://pendleton.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/child-and-youth/new-parent-support)
- [Readiness and Deployment Support](https://pendleton.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/military-family-life/readiness-and-deployment-support)

sections.heading: Prevention and Counseling
sections.markdown:
Using an integrated community health approach, the Community Counseling Program equips Marines and families with resources and support.

**Programs:**
- [Community Counseling](https://pendleton.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/prevention-and-counseling/community-counseling)
- [Substance Assessment and Counseling Program](https://pendleton.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/prevention-and-counseling/substance-assessment-and-counseling-program)
- [Domestic Abuse](https://pendleton.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/prevention-and-counseling/domestic-abuse)
- [Sexual Assault Prevention and Response](https://pendleton.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/prevention-and-counseling/sexual-assault-prevention-and-response)
- [Substance Misuse](https://pendleton.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/prevention-and-counseling/substance-misuse)
- [Suicide Prevention](https://pendleton.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/prevention-and-counseling/suicide-prevention)
- [Military OneSource](https://pendleton.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/prevention-and-counseling/military-onesource)
- [Semper Support](https://pendleton.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/prevention-and-counseling/semper-support)

sections.heading: Personal Financial Management
sections.markdown: We provide professional training and guidance to help you and your family manage money successfully and build long-term financial security.

sections.heading: Retired Affairs
sections.markdown: Support Services provided to assist Military Retirees.

sections.heading: Single Marine Program
sections.markdown: The Single Marine Program enhances the quality of life for single, active duty personnel by providing resources and community engagement opportunities.

sections.heading: Transition Readiness Program
sections.markdown:
We prepare Marines for the civilian workforce through the Transition Readiness Program by providing comprehensive career support and resources.

**Programs:**
- [Marine For Life Network](https://pendleton.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/transition-readiness-program/marine-for-life-network)
- [SkillBridge](https://pendleton.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/transition-readiness-program/skillbridge)
- [Career Services](https://pendleton.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/education/career-services)

sections.heading: Voluntary Education
sections.markdown: We provide professional guidance, tools, and support to help you successfully reach your educational goals.

sections.heading: Volunteer Opportunities
sections.markdown: We connect you with meaningful volunteering opportunities that strengthen the military community and support those in need.
